text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finance Ministry to pay non-Kuwaiti employees of Health Ministry for working during 1990-91 Iraqi occupation.
- Some 22 prisoners at Central Prison attempt suicide. The prison has been plagued for several weeks by fueding among inmates and riots demanding an ease in security measures.
- Kuwait to amend five laws in an attempt to increase the employment of Kuwaitis, official source says. Some 700,000 of the country's two million population are Kuwaiti nationals.
- British guided missile destroyer HMS Southampton to hold war games with Kuwait in April.
